recognize_zh: CD10 免疫染色中整片單形性腫瘤細胞完全呈藍色陰性，只有少數血管/基質呈淡棕色可作為內部對照；典型伯奇氏淋巴瘤（Burkitt lymphoma）應為 CD10 陽性，所以這張 CD10 陰性的結果屬於少見情況，需重新審視診斷並依靠 MYC 檢測與其他標記。
features: Diffuse monotonous sheet of tumor cells negative for CD10
Faint staining limited to scattered vessels/stromal elements (internal positive control)
Medium-sized round nuclei on hematoxylin counterstain
No membranous staining of tumor cells
No germinal center-like CD10-positive clusters in this field
describe_en: CD10 immunostain shows a diffuse, monotonous population of medium-sized tumor cells that are negative for CD10. Only faint staining of scattered vascular/stromal elements is present, serving as an internal control. Of note, classic Burkitt lymphoma is characteristically CD10-positive; CD10 negativity is uncommon and should prompt careful exclusion of other high-grade B-cell lymphomas. The stain is interpreted as negative, which is partially concordant with the stated diagnosis and requires correlation with BCL6, BCL2, TdT, Ki-67 and MYC/BCL2/BCL6 FISH.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, non-germinal center type
ddx.vs: Non-GCB DLBCL is CD10-negative and MUM1-positive with larger pleomorphic cells and a lower Ki-67 than Burkitt lymphoma.
Cases with Burkitt-like morphology but discordant phenotype (e.g., CD10-negative or BCL2-positive) without double-hit rearrangements fall here.
Blastoid MCL is CD10-negative but expresses cyclin D1, SOX11 and usually CD5.
B-LBL can be CD10-variable but expresses TdT and CD34 and lacks surface immunoglobulin.
